svg.text: More coil banks can be added radially and axially,
each tuned to a slice of the alpha energy spread.
a = width of one turn; n = turns per coil
v = alpha speed at that coil
tank: f = N · f_pkt (N ≈ 2-4), same for every coil
Stage 2 sees slower alphas → smaller a
Stage 2: a₂ = 0.86 a (≈ 7 MeV vs 9.5 MeV alphas)
e.g. 0.5 m p cavity: f_pkt ≈ 8.06 MHz, N = 3
Each coil accepts Δv/v ≈ 1/(2n) (≈ ±5 % for 10 turns)
Tank: coil L with C + C_trim, f = 1/(2π√(L·C_total)),
